title: varronia bellonis

This plant has been traditionally used in African folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Varronia bellonis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
